audit.requirements_source: brief.docx - Programimi ne ueb II, Udhezimet per projekt grupor '25 (Faza 1: 13 prill, Faza 2: 17 maj)

categories.name: requirements_compliance
categories.justification: 41 mandatory items: 26 Met, 11 Partially met, 4 Not met (76.8%); both optional items Met.

categories.name: code_quality
categories.justification: Readable logic with Albanian validation messages, but concrete bugs (sponsor column, undefined $numberCount, id/request_id mismatch), dead and duplicated code.

categories.name: structure_architecture
categories.justification: Flat root with ~50 PHP files, classes inside templates, hard-coded /UEB25_GR3/ paths; some separation in helpers/, api/, includes/.

categories.name: security
categories.justification: Prepared statements and password_hash throughout, but admin endpoints lack authorization, unrestricted uploads, stored XSS and hard-coded secrets.

categories.name: testing
categories.justification: No automated tests or CI; only a manual echo script (test_helpers.php). Not required by the brief.

categories.name: maintainability_documentation
categories.justification: README documents features and team split accurately; no install/DB setup instructions; descriptive commit messages.

categories.name: production_readiness
categories.justification: Course project: root DB user without password, committed logs/cache, display_errors and CORS * on one endpoint.

categories.name: performance
categories.justification: Inferred: 1h file cache for the flight API; redundant API call in flights.php; unpaginated news queries (negligible at this scale).

categories.name: dependencies
categories.justification: PHPMailer vendored twice (PHPMailer-master/ and vendor/), composer unused by code, three jQuery versions.

cap.reason: No cap: course (not production-oriented) project so the secret/critical-vulnerability cap does not apply; mandatory compliance above 40%; no confirmed copying.

history_signals: 449 commits (282 non-merge) over 36 active days, 2024-12-09 to 2025-05-25, by 5 people matching README team list.
Repository is a fork of the team's original repo olsadomi/Airport_Website-Gr3 (fork created 2025-06-21).
All Phase 2 commits dated 2025-05-20..25, after the brief's Phase 2 submission date (17 May 2025); needs verification.
51% of lines added in the last 7 days; largely PHPMailer vendoring (700d4d0: 12,061 lines; 3302972: 10,844 lines/78 files).
2 commits look like GitHub web uploads; 1 duplicate commit from squash/rebase.

ai_assistance.policy_assessment: AI policy unspecified: estimate reported without penalty; no AI disclosure in README.

findings.title: Unrestricted, unauthenticated file upload (possible code execution)
findings.evidence: Original filename via basename($_FILES[...]['name']) saved into public fotot/, Photos/, uploads/ with no extension or MIME check; news-insert.php and admin_sponsors.php require no admin session.
findings.impact: Anonymous visitor may upload a .php file to a web-served folder; on default XAMPP/Apache it would execute.
findings.recommendation: Whitelist image types with finfo + extension, randomize file names, disable PHP execution in upload folders, and require admin auth.

findings.title: Admin pages and actions lack authorization checks
findings.evidence: Only admin_dashboard.php:4, news-admin.php:5, edit-news.php:5 check user_role === 'admin'; delete-news.php deletes via GET without a session.
findings.impact: Any visitor can delete/insert news and sponsors, read contact PII, and send emails/newsletters as the airport.
findings.recommendation: Add a shared require_admin.php guard to every admin/action script; use POST + CSRF token for deletes.

findings.title: Hard-coded secrets in source
findings.evidence: aviationstack key 'ef21...fcb', SMTP password 'Re2j...' (Ethereal), superadmin plaintext password, all in public repo; not detected by the automated scanner.
findings.impact: API key abuse; publicly known admin password.
findings.recommendation: Move secrets to an untracked config/.env, rotate the API key, remove the password from the script.

findings.title: Stored XSS in news and sponsor listings
findings.evidence: Title, description, category, image path and sponsor name echoed without htmlspecialchars.
findings.impact: Combined with F-02, an anonymous user can inject script executed for every visitor of the news page.
findings.recommendation: Escape all output with htmlspecialchars as already done in post-details.php:67-72.

findings.title: Phase 2 work committed after the brief's submission date
findings.evidence: Brief: 'Faza 2: 17 maj dorezimi'. First Phase 2 commit 2025-05-20; 51 commits on 2025-05-25 including cookie, sponsors admin, superadmin.
findings.impact: If no extension was granted, most graded Phase 2 features were added after submission.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the real deadline; if needed, grade the last commit before it.

findings.title: Functional bugs found by static reading
findings.evidence: Insert into non-existent column sponsor_name; undefined $numberCount; request_id vs id mismatch so replied_at never set; form field names differ from read keys; arrivals re-fetched overriding fallback and sort; stray '}{}'; any navbar click logs the user out.
findings.impact: Seed sponsors, digit count, reply status and form repopulation do not work as claimed.
findings.recommendation: Align column/field names, remove dead code and the duplicate fetch.

findings.title: Duplicated configuration and dependencies
findings.evidence: DB credentials in 6 files, SMTP config in 4, PHPMailer in both PHPMailer-master/ and vendor/, jQuery 3.6.0/3.6.4/3.7.1 loaded.
findings.impact: Changes must be repeated; heavier pages; inconsistent behavior.
findings.recommendation: Single db.php and mailer helper; one PHPMailer via vendor/autoload.php; one jQuery.

findings.title: Debug artifacts and logs committed; verbose errors
findings.evidence: Runtime logs/cache in git, debug writes on every load, CORS *, display_errors=1, POST data logged.
findings.impact: Information leakage and noise; test scripts publicly reachable.
findings.recommendation: Add .gitignore for logs/cache, remove debug writes and test scripts from web root.

findings.title: README lacks installation and database setup instructions
findings.evidence: Feature claims match code (cookies for news, Web API, sessions, AJAX, superadmin); missing DB name, create_* order, /UEB25_GR3/ path and demo admin login.
findings.impact: Project cannot be reproduced without reading the code.
findings.recommendation: Add an 'Instalimi' section; clarify that only the email step of parking reservation requires login.

limitations: No execution: code, database, external API and email sending were not run; all verdicts are static.
Requirement parser returned 0 items; R1-R43 were extracted manually from the brief text.
No corpus of other groups' submissions; cross-group copying not checked.
No GITHUB_TOKEN: GitHub code search for distinctive lines skipped; candidates found by name only; GitHub API rate-limited.
Configured deadline was '-'; the 17 May 2025 date comes from the brief and was not applied to the score.
Automated secret scan missed hard-coded credentials; full git history (git log -p) was not scanned for further secrets.
No vulnerability database was available for dependency CVE checks.
One contributor account (bleronbaftiu21) resembles the requesting user's name; flagged for the human reviewer's awareness.
